faq.title: Got Questions? We've Got Answers
faq.q1: How fast can my website or web app be delivered?
faq.a1: Most landing pages take 5–7 days, while fullstack company profiles, booking systems, or custom dashboards are typically shipped in 2–4 weeks.
faq.q2: What tech stack do you use?
faq.a2: I primarily build with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and PostgreSQL — deployed on Vercel or cloud infrastructure for fast performance.
faq.q3: Can you integrate WhatsApp AI chatbots and Payment Gateways?
faq.a3: Yes. I integrate Midtrans/Xendit payment flows and automated AI chatbots for WhatsApp, Instagram, and web directly into your system.
faq.q4: Do you provide post-launch support and maintenance?
faq.a4: Every project includes post-launch support, bug fixes, and optional ongoing maintenance as your business grows.
